rows.emqx:associated-marketing-manager:
Bay Area, CA
Associated Marketing Manager
Snapshot - Company: EMQ Technologies Inc., creator of EMQX, a real-time messaging and streaming data platform for IoT, AI, and event-driven applications. - Culture: Open-source roots with an engineer-first mindset; trusted by global customers at scale. - Role: Hands-on Individual Contributor translating product and solution strategy into scalable marketing programs and clear value propositions for technical and business buyers. - This role is open to early-career candidates and new graduates with strong internships, project experience, or demonstrated interest in B2B software marketing. ## Core Responsibilities - Translate product and solution strategy into scalable marketing programs, including B2B demand generation and sales enablement support. - Plan and execute product launches and demand generation campaigns. - Drive marketing- and partner-sourced leads in alignment with Sales and SDRs. - Develop messaging that turns technical capabilities into clear customer value. - Measure campaign performance using marketing analytics and optimize programs for revenue impact and attribution. ## Must Have - Strong interest in B2B software marketing. - Ability to learn technical products quickly and turn features into customer value. - Effective communication of real-time, streaming, or AI-related concepts. - Experience working with Sales, SDRs, and Partners. - Authorized to work in the United States and based in Bay area. ## Nice to Have - Background in IoT platforms, real-time messaging, and AI-enabled systems. - Experience in open-source or high-growth SaaS environments. - Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo. ## Benefits Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan.
rows.emqx:regional-vice-president-of-sales:
Greater Boston Area
Regional Vice President of Sales
About EMQ EMQ is the team behind EMQX, the world's leading open-source messaging and streaming data platform for IoT, AI, and event-driven applications. We are looking for an experienced and highly driven Regional Vice President of Sales, East to lead and grow our business across the Eastern U.S. This is a dynamic "Player-Coach" role designed for a seasoned sales leader. You will be responsible for sales performance across the Eastern U.S., including regional pipeline, bookings, and forecast accuracy. ## Core Responsibilities - Own and drive sales results for the Eastern U.S. region, including pipeline growth, bookings, and forecast accuracy. - Directly manage and mentor a focused team currently consisting of Key Account (KA) Executives and SMB Account Executives. Provide hands-on coaching in deal strategy, negotiation, and pipeline management. - Personally own and lead a select number of strategic enterprise accounts and marquee opportunities. Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals from initial discovery to closing. - Implement consistent sales processes and pipeline discipline, with strong CRM hygiene and forecasting rigor across both enterprise and SMB motions. - Partner closely with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to refine go-to-market execution and strengthen messaging for target accounts and industries in the East region. ## Must Have - 12+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience, with at least 5+ years in a regional sales management or Player-Coach role. - Proven background at large-scale or established B2B software companies, with a deep understanding of mature sales operations and methodologies. - Demonstrated success in selling complex, highly technical solutions (e.g., Infrastructure, Data Streaming, Cloud, or Open-Source software) to both technical decision-makers (CTOs, Architects) and business executives. - A dual-track mindset: Capable of navigating 6-12 month enterprise sales cycles while simultaneously guiding an SMB rep through high-velocity, transactional deals. - Strong track record of consistently meeting or exceeding regional quotas. - Located in the Greater Boston Area. ## Nice to Have - Domain expertise in IoT platforms, real-time messaging (MQTT, Kafka), or AI-enabled systems. - Experience building or scaling a regional sales footprint from an early stage to a mature operation. - Familiarity with executing Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies in conjunction with field marketing teams. - Experience working with channel or solution partners. - Experience selling to customers in manufacturing, automotive, energy, logistics, or other industrial/connected industries.
rows.emqx:sales-representative:
North America
Sales Representative

rows.emqx:sr-strategic-sales-executive:
Greater Boston Area
Sr. Strategic Sales Executive

Our platform bridges the physical world and artificial intelligence, transforming IoT data streams into intelligent, actionable insights through a unified, scalable solution. Key Responsibilities: Account Strategy & Planning:
Maintain a strategic, focused account list based on target industries and use cases.
Maintain written strategic account and opportunity plans, and keep customer and opportunity data current in the CRM system.
Maintain an accurate forecast to achieve quarterly and annual goals.

Pipeline & Demand Generation:
Develop pipeline using strategic outbound messaging, ecosystem partners, and existing relationships.
Use value and consultative selling to create demand and close strategic deals with executive-level influencers and decision makers.

Relationship & Deal Execution:
Develop consultative business and technical relationships with key influencers and decision makers.
Orchestrate technical product demonstrations and POCs.
Orchestrate closure of complex sales contracts and legal documents between the customer and EMQ executives and legal team.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Market Insight:
Collaborate with the Marketing Team in planning, organizing, and implementing events.
Understand the strengths and weaknesses of competing products, industry trends, and ecosystem dynamics.

Skills & Qualifications: Education:
BS/BA Degree; MS/MBA a plus.

Sales Experience:
10+ years of strategic SaaS sales experience in a quota-bearing, closing capacity.
Track record of success in achieving or exceeding assigned sales goals.
Demonstrated success using a consultative, solutions/value-oriented sales approach in a team selling environment.

Market Knowledge:
A good understanding of Enterprise Software, IoV, or IIoT markets.
Experience in IoT, IoV, embedded software sales, OEM marketplace, etc., is a plus; subscription sales experience is preferred.

Core Skills:
Intense hunting and prospecting skills, with a thorough understanding of marketing and negotiating techniques.
Aptitude in delivering attractive presentations.
Excellent customer development, communication, and public relations skills.
Hands-on experience with CRM software; Salesforce is a plus.

Attributes:
Fast learner with a passion for sales.
Self-motivated with a results-driven approach.

Location & Authorization:
Located in the Greater Boston area, with the ability to travel.
US work authorization required.

rows.emqx:technical-account-executive-commerc:
Bay Area, CA
Technical Account Executive, Commercial - West
About EMQ EMQ is the team behind EMQX, a leading open-source messaging and streaming data platform for IoT, AI, and event-driven applications. Trusted by customers around the world, EMQX helps organizations connect devices, move data in real time, and build reliable, scalable systems for modern connected applications.
About the Role We’re hiring a Commercial Account Executive to own the SMB and commercial segment across the Western U.S. This is a full-cycle role for a technically minded seller who can independently run discovery, demos, and commercial conversations, while engaging both technical and business buyers. You’ll work closely with our Menlo Park team and partner with SDRs, Marketing, and Solutions Engineering as needed.
Core Responsibilities Own the full sales cycle for SMB and commercial accounts across the Western US: from first inbound conversation through close, including qualification, discovery, technical demo, POC scoping, commercial negotiation, and contract execution.
Run your own product demos. You'll be the primary technical voice in most of your deals, comfortable walking a developer or architect through EMQX's architecture, features, and deployment options without needing an SE in the room.
Manage a high-velocity pipeline. Typical deal sizes range from $10K to $100K ACV, with sales cycles of 2 to 12 weeks. You’ll be expected to manage a high-volume pipeline and close a meaningful number of deals each quarter in a fast-moving commercial environment.
Engage both technical and economic buyers. You'll talk to backend engineers, platform leads, and architects about MQTT, distributed systems, and IoT architectures, and you'll talk to engineering managers, directors, and VPs of Engineering about budget, procurement, and ROI
Partner with SDRs and Marketing on outbound campaigns, ABM plays, field events, and inbound lead follow-up across your territory
Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene in Salesforce: accurate forecasts, clean pipeline, timely next steps. Predictability matters
Provide feedback from prospects and customers to help improve messaging, positioning, and go-to-market execution in the West region
Must Have 3+ years of B2B software sales experience in a full-cycle closing role
Experience selling SMB or commercial accounts in a fast-moving environment
Ability to independently manage the full sales process from opportunity qualification through close
Strong discovery, demo, objection handling, and negotiation skills
Experience selling technical or infrastructure-oriented software, such as cloud, developer tools, data, security, networking, IoT, or related platforms
Proven ability to independently run technical product demos for engineers and architects, without relying on a Solutions Engineer for standard product walkthroughs
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical stakeholders and business decision-makers
Strong CRM discipline, pipeline management, and forecasting habits
Based in the Bay Area and able to work in a hybrid model out of the Menlo Park office
Nice to Have Background in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Experience selling open-source, infrastructure, or developer-oriented software.
Experience converting open-source users, free-tier accounts, or PLG-driven inbound leads into paying commercial customers.
Familiarity with messaging, streaming, MQTT, Kafka, pub/sub messaging, cloud infrastructure, or IoT platforms.
Experience working with Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools
Experience selling into industries such as manufacturing, automotive, logistics, energy, or connected products
